methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Norfolk native brings free AI workshops to Hampton Roads to close the technology gap - WTKR
signals.signal_reading: Free AI workshops delivered by a Norfolk native to close the technology gap signals grassroots capability-building through peer networks, potentially distributing deep AI fluency beyond traditional tech hubs if sustained.

signals.title: ‘Shaping our future’: Company powering AI data centers invests $50+ million in Henrico, adding 200 jobs - WWBT
signals.signal_reading: A $50M+ AI data center infrastructure investment adding 200 jobs in Henrico reinforces Richmond's emergence as a concentrated AI capability hub, deepening the metro advantage while leaving rural regions further behind.

signals.title: Roanoke College joins Google AI for Education Accelerator - Roanoke College
signals.signal_reading: Roanoke College joining Google's AI Education Accelerator suggests platform-delivered AI adoption reaching beyond NoVA, but reliance on corporate tooling rather than indigenous development points toward shallow, distributed implementation.

signals.title: Camp Welcomes Hampton Roads Youth to Learn About Cybersecurity and AI - Old Dominion University
signals.signal_reading: ODU's cybersecurity and AI camp for Hampton Roads youth represents institutional investment in deep technical literacy outside NoVA, building foundational capabilities that could distribute AI fluency through the next generation.

signals.title: AI pressure grows on Richmond's young workforce - Axios
signals.signal_reading: AI pressure on Richmond's young workforce without corresponding training infrastructure signals demand outpacing capability development, risking shallow adoption or displacement rather than deep skill-building in a metro hub.
